name: Mizushima Akari
source:
A young lady who has been the target of the protagonist's unrequited love for quite some time now. She is a year older than the protagonist, and they often chance upon each other because she happens to be the best friend of Aoi.

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/tonari/character111.html]Official Site[/url]]
